source: frozen virtual unapproved contract: 20 criteria and 57 chunks

policy.trace: completed explicit run, 0..4 rule dependencies, source scope/version/hash matched, applied exception evidence retained historically
policy.exceptions: all ancestor states approved, scope matched, same medium, valid [start,end), proof required, 1..4 levels, no repeated nodes
policy.impact: changed source to direct/transitive rule or exception and latest completed run per asset, failed/newer and old completed excluded

measurement.timer: execute through full consumption; wire and decode included, connection and oracle outside

limits: synthetic workflow and exceptions; no production approvals
programmatic oracle with explicit canaries, not human adjudicated labels
query-only local Docker; no OCR LLM API UI or human labor timing
